name: Carbamazepin
summary: Carbamazepine, sold under the brand name Tegretol among others, is an anticonvulsant medication used in the treatment of epilepsy and neuropathic pain. It is used as an adjunctive treatment in schizophrenia along with other medications and as a second-line agent in bipolar disorder. Carbamazepine appears to work as well as phenytoin and valproate for focal and generalized seizures.

pharmacology.text: Carbamazepine is a sodium channel blocker. It binds preferentially to voltage-gated sodium channels in their inactive conformation, which prevents repetitive and sustained firing of an action potential. Carbamazepine has effects on serotonin systems but the relevance to its antiseizure effects is uncertain. There is evidence that it is a serotonin releasing agent and possibly even a serotonin reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Carbamazepine is typically used for the treatment of seizure disorders and neuropathic pain. It is used off-label as a second-line treatment for bipolar disorder and in combination with an antipsychotic in some cases of schizophrenia when treatment with a conventional antipsychotic alone has failed. However, evidence does not support its usage for schizophrenia. It is not effective for absence seizures or myoclonic seizures.

summaryZh: 卡馬西平 ，常見商品名 Tegretol（得理多），是一種治療癲癇和神經性疼痛的抗癲癇藥。它可作為輔助藥物，與其他藥物一起治療精神病，並用作治療雙相情緒障礙症的二線藥物。卡馬西平對於局部性和全身性癲癇發作的作用似乎與苯妥英和丙戊酸一樣有效。它對於失神癲癇發作或肌陣攣發作無治療效果。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include dizziness, drowsiness, unsteadiness, nausea and double vision. Serious risks include severe skin reactions such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome, which are much more likely in people carrying the HLA-B*1502 gene, common in people of East and Southeast Asian descent. It can also lower blood cell counts and sodium levels, harm the liver and harm an unborn baby.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括頭暈、嗜睡、步態不穩、噁心與複視。嚴重風險包括史蒂文斯-強森症候群等重度皮膚反應，帶有 HLA-B*1502 基因者風險高得多，而這種基因在東亞與東南亞族群中很常見。它也可能降低血球數量與血鈉濃度、損害肝臟，並傷害胎兒。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括头晕、嗜睡、步态不稳、恶心与复视。严重风险包括史蒂文斯-强森症候群等重度皮肤反应，带有 HLA-B*1502 基因者风险高得多，而这种基因在东亚与东南亚族群中很常见。它也可能降低血球数量与血钠浓度、损害肝脏，并伤害胎儿。

fact.en: Carbamazepine was first made in 1953 by the chemist Walter Schindler at Geigy in Switzerland. Its three-ring structure is very close to that of the tricyclic antidepressant imipramine.
fact.zh: 卡馬西平在 1953 年由瑞士嘉基公司的化學家華特·辛德勒首次合成。它的三環結構與三環抗憂鬱藥丙咪嗪非常相似。
fact.zhHans: 卡马西平在 1953 年由瑞士嘉基公司的化学家华特·辛德勒首次合成。它的三环结构与三环抗忧郁药丙咪嗪非常相似。
